column1: # abbr|English|中文（《天文学名词》）|brightest-star names code:English:中文;...|一句话（自写事实）|one line (own facts)
And|Andromeda|仙女座|alf:Alpheratz:壁宿二;bet:Mirach:奎宿九|秋夜高挂，附近能看到仙女座星系的模糊光斑。|High on autumn nights; the Andromeda Galaxy is a faint smudge nearby.
Ant|Antlia|唧筒座||南天小星座，名字来自一种抽气机。|A small southern constellation named after an air pump.
Aps|Apus|天燕座||靠近南天极，在中国大部分地方看不到。|Close to the south celestial pole; not visible from most of China.
Aqr|Aquarius|宝瓶座|bet:Sadalsuud:虚宿一;alf:Sadalmelik:危宿一|黄道星座，秋夜南方一片暗淡的星。|A zodiac constellation of faint stars low in the south in autumn.
Aql|Aquila|天鹰座|alf:Altair:河鼓二|最亮的星就是牛郎星，夏季大三角的一角。|Its brightest star Altair is one corner of the Summer Triangle.
Ara|Ara|天坛座||南天的祭坛，夏天在南方地平线附近。|A southern altar, low on the southern horizon in summer.
Ari|Aries|白羊座|alf:Hamal:娄宿三|黄道星座，三颗星排成一条弯钩。|A zodiac constellation; three stars form a short hook.
Aur|Auriga|御夫座|alf:Capella:五车二|五边形里有五车二，全天第六亮的星。|A pentagon holding Capella, the sixth-brightest star.
Boo|Bootes|牧夫座|alf:Arcturus:大角|顺着北斗的勺柄弧线，就能找到大角。|Follow the arc of the Big Dipper's handle to Arcturus.
Cae|Caelum|雕具座||南天很暗的小星座，形状像雕刻刀。|A dim little southern constellation shaped like a chisel.
Cam|Camelopardalis|鹿豹座||面积很大却很暗，在北极星附近。|Large but faint, lying near Polaris.
Cnc|Cancer|巨蟹座|bet:Tarf:柳宿增十|黄道上最暗的星座，中间有鬼星团。|The faintest zodiac constellation, with the Beehive Cluster.
CVn|Canes Venatici|猎犬座|alf02:Cor Caroli:常陈一|藏在北斗勺柄下方的两颗星。|Two stars tucked under the Big Dipper's handle.
CMa|Canis Major|大犬座|alf:Sirius:天狼星|有天狼星，夜空中最亮的恒星。|Home of Sirius, the brightest star of the night sky.
CMi|Canis Minor|小犬座|alf:Procyon:南河三|只有两颗亮星，南河三是冬季大三角一角。|Two bright stars; Procyon is a corner of the Winter Triangle.
Cap|Capricornus|摩羯座|del:Deneb Algedi:垒壁阵四|黄道星座，秋夜南方的一个大三角形。|A zodiac constellation drawn as a wide triangle in autumn.
Car|Carina|船底座|alf:Canopus:老人星|老人星是全天第二亮，在中国南方才看得到。|Canopus is the second-brightest star, seen only from the far south.
Cas|Cassiopeia|仙后座|alf:Schedar:王良四;gam::|一个明显的 W，和北斗分在北极星两边。|A bright W shape on the opposite side of Polaris from the Dipper.
Cen|Centaurus|半人马座|alf:Rigil Kentaurus:南门二|南门二是离太阳最近的恒星系统。|Alpha Centauri is the nearest star system to the Sun.
Cep|Cepheus|仙王座|alf:Alderamin:天钩五|像一座小房子，靠近北极星。|Shaped like a small house near Polaris.
Cet|Cetus|鲸鱼座|bet:Diphda:土司空|很大的海怪，里面的米拉是著名变星。|A large sea monster; its star Mira is a famous variable.
Cha|Chamaeleon|蝘蜓座||靠近南天极的小星座。|A small constellation near the south celestial pole.
Cir|Circinus|圆规座||南门二旁边一个窄窄的小三角。|A narrow little triangle next to Alpha Centauri.
Col|Columba|天鸽座|alf:Phact:丈人一|冬夜在大犬座西南、离地平线很近。|Low in winter, southwest of Canis Major.
Com|Coma Berenices|后发座||很暗，但这一片有很多遥远的星系。|Faint, but the area is full of distant galaxies.
CrA|Corona Australis|南冕座|alf:Meridiana:鳖一;bet::|人马座下方一圈弧形的小星。|A small arc of stars below Sagittarius.
CrB|Corona Borealis|北冕座|alf:Alphecca:贯索四|七颗星围成半个圆圈，像一顶王冠。|Seven stars curve into a half circle like a crown.
Crv|Corvus|乌鸦座|gam:Gienah:轸宿一|春夜南方四颗星组成的小四边形。|Four stars make a small quadrilateral in the spring south.
Crt|Crater|巨爵座||乌鸦座旁边一只暗淡的杯子。|A faint cup next to Corvus.
Cru|Crux|南十字座|alf01:Acrux:十字架二|全天最小的星座，在南半球很好认。|The smallest constellation, easy to spot from the south.
Cyg|Cygnus|天鹅座|alf:Deneb:天津四|北十字，天津四是夏季大三角一角。|The Northern Cross; Deneb is a corner of the Summer Triangle.
Del|Delphinus|海豚座|bet:Rotanev:瓠瓜四|一个小菱形加一条尾巴，像跃起的海豚。|A small diamond with a tail, like a leaping dolphin.
Dor|Dorado|剑鱼座||里面有大麦哲伦云，银河系的邻居。|Holds the Large Magellanic Cloud, a neighbour galaxy.
Dra|Draco|天龙座|gam:Eltanin:天棓四|一条长龙绕在小熊座周围。|A long dragon winding around the Little Bear.
Equ|Equuleus|小马座||全天第二小的星座，就在海豚座旁边。|The second-smallest constellation, beside Delphinus.
Eri|Eridanus|波江座|alf:Achernar:水委一|一条长长的河，从猎户脚边一直流到南天。|A long river flowing south from Orion's foot.
For|Fornax|天炉座||南天一片暗区，名字来自化学炉。|A dim southern patch named after a chemist's furnace.
Gem|Gemini|双子座|bet:Pollux:北河三;alf:Castor:北河二|两颗亮星并排，像一对双胞胎。|Two bright stars side by side like twins.
Gru|Grus|天鹤座|alf:Alnair:鹤一|秋天南方低空，一只伸长脖子的鹤。|A crane stretching its neck, low in the autumn south.
Her|Hercules|武仙座|bet:Kornephoros:河中;alf01:Rasalgethi:帝座|中间的四边形旁有 M13 球状星团。|The Keystone hosts the M13 globular cluster.
Hor|Horologium|时钟座||南天很暗的一串星，像摆钟。|A dim southern line of stars like a pendulum clock.
Hya|Hydra|长蛇座|alf:Alphard:星宿一|全天面积最大的星座，横跨春季南天。|The largest constellation, stretching across the spring sky.
Hyi|Hydrus|水蛇座||靠近南天极，在小麦哲伦云旁边。|Near the south pole, beside the Small Magellanic Cloud.
Ind|Indus|印第安座||南天的暗星座，夏末在南方低空。|A faint southern constellation low in late summer.
Lac|Lacerta|蝎虎座||夹在仙后和天鹅之间的一条锯齿。|A zigzag between Cassiopeia and Cygnus.
Leo|Leo|狮子座|alf:Regulus:轩辕十四|狮头像一个反写的问号，春夜最好认。|The head is a backwards question mark, easy in spring.
LMi|Leo Minor|小狮座|46:Praecipua:势四|狮子座上方几颗暗星。|A few faint stars above Leo.
Lep|Lepus|天兔座|alf:Arneb:厕一|蹲在猎户脚下的一只兔子。|A hare crouching at Orion's feet.
Lib|Libra|天秤座|bet:Zubeneschamali:氐宿四;alf02:Zubenelgenubi:氐宿一|黄道星座，夹在室女和天蝎之间。|A zodiac constellation between Virgo and Scorpius.
Lup|Lupus|豺狼座||天蝎座西边，夏天在南方低空。|West of Scorpius, low in the summer south.
Lyn|Lynx|天猫座||很暗，据说要有猞猁的眼睛才能看见。|So faint you need a lynx's eyes to see it.
Lyr|Lyra|天琴座|alf:Vega:织女一|织女星所在，夏季大三角最亮的一角。|Home of Vega, the brightest corner of the Summer Triangle.
Men|Mensa|山案座||全天最暗的星座，在南天极附近。|The faintest constellation, near the south pole.
Mic|Microscopium|显微镜座||摩羯座南边一小片暗星。|A small faint patch south of Capricornus.
Mon|Monoceros|麒麟座||夹在冬季大三角里面，星都很暗。|Inside the Winter Triangle; all its stars are faint.
Mus|Musca|苍蝇座||在南十字座正下方。|Right below the Southern Cross.
Nor|Norma|矩尺座||南天银河里一把木工尺。|A carpenter's square in the southern Milky Way.
Oct|Octans|南极座||南天极就在这个星座里。|The south celestial pole lies in this constellation.
Oph|Ophiuchus|蛇夫座|alf:Rasalhague:候|手里握着巨蛇，太阳每年也会经过这里。|Holds the serpent; the Sun passes through it each year.
Ori|Orion|猎户座|bet:Rigel:参宿七;alf:Betelgeuse:参宿四|三颗腰带星排成一线，冬夜最好认。|Three belt stars in a row, the easiest winter sight.
Pav|Pavo|孔雀座|alf:Peacock:孔雀十一|南天的孔雀，中国南方夏夜低空可见。|A southern peacock, low in summer from south China.
Peg|Pegasus|飞马座|eps:Enif:危宿三|秋季四边形是它的身体。|The Great Square of autumn is its body.
Per|Perseus|英仙座|alf:Mirfak:天船三|每年 8 月英仙座流星雨从这里放射出来。|The August Perseid meteors seem to come from here.
Phe|Phoenix|凤凰座|alf:Ankaa:火鸟六|秋天南方低空的一只凤凰。|A phoenix low in the autumn south.
Pic|Pictor|绘架座||老人星旁边一个画家的画架。|A painter's easel next to Canopus.
PsA|Piscis Austrinus|南鱼座|alf:Fomalhaut:北落师门|北落师门是秋夜南方唯一的亮星。|Fomalhaut is the only bright star in the autumn south.
Psc|Pisces|双鱼座|eta:Alpherg:右更二|两条鱼用一根长绳拴着，星都很暗。|Two fish tied by a long cord, all faint stars.
Pup|Puppis|船尾座|zet:Naos:弧矢增二十二|原来的大船座被拆成三份，这是船尾。|The stern of the old ship Argo, split into three.
Pyx|Pyxis|罗盘座||船帆旁边的一只航海罗盘。|A ship's compass beside Vela.
Ret|Reticulum|网罟座||南天一个小菱形。|A small diamond in the far south.
Sge|Sagitta|天箭座||天鹰和天鹅之间一支小箭。|A small arrow between Aquila and Cygnus.
Sgr|Sagittarius|人马座|eps:Kaus Australis:箕宿三|形状像茶壶，银河系中心就在这个方向。|Shaped like a teapot; the Milky Way's centre lies this way.
Sco|Scorpius|天蝎座|alf:Antares:心宿二|夏夜南方的蝎子，红色的心宿二是蝎心。|A summer scorpion with red Antares as its heart.
Scl|Sculptor|玉夫座||南天暗星座，南银极就在这里。|A faint southern area holding the south galactic pole.
Sct|Scutum|盾牌座||一面小盾牌，挡在银河很亮的一段上。|A small shield over a bright stretch of the Milky Way.
Ser|Serpens|巨蛇座|alf:Unukalhai:天市右垣七|唯一被分成两块的星座：蛇头和蛇尾。|The only constellation in two parts: head and tail.
Sex|Sextans|六分仪座||狮子座南边，星都很暗。|South of Leo; all its stars are faint.
Tau|Taurus|金牛座|alf:Aldebaran:毕宿五|红色的毕宿五是牛眼，旁边是昴星团。|Red Aldebaran is the bull's eye, near the Pleiades.
Tel|Telescopium|望远镜座||人马座南边一小片暗星。|A faint patch south of Sagittarius.
Tri|Triangulum|三角座||三颗星一个三角形，里面有三角星系。|Three stars in a triangle, holding the Triangulum Galaxy.
TrA|Triangulum Australe|南三角座|alf:Atria:三角形三|南天三颗亮星组成的三角形。|A bright triangle of three southern stars.
Tuc|Tucana|杜鹃座||小麦哲伦云就在这里。|Home of the Small Magellanic Cloud.
UMa|Ursa Major|大熊座|eps:Alioth:玉衡;alf:Dubhe:天枢|北斗七星是大熊的背和尾巴。|The Big Dipper is the bear's back and tail.
UMi|Ursa Minor|小熊座|alf:Polaris:北极星|北极星在小熊尾巴尖上，几乎不动。|Polaris sits at the tail tip and barely moves.
Vel|Vela|船帆座||大船座的帆，在南方低空的银河里。|The sails of Argo, low in the southern Milky Way.
Vir|Virgo|室女座|alf:Spica:角宿一|面积第二大，角宿一是春夜南方亮星。|The second-largest constellation; Spica shines in spring.
Vol|Volans|飞鱼座||船底座下面一条飞鱼。|A flying fish below Carina.
Vul|Vulpecula|狐狸座|alf:Anser:齐增五|天鹅座南边的暗星座，有哑铃星云。|A faint fox south of Cygnus, with the Dumbbell Nebula.
